deck.game_version_binding_basis: QR at 0 s closes directly into New deck 16 in the Event queue at 2 s. No intervening deck edit is shown; all filmed owner cards agree with the semantic QR list.

filmed_deck_snapshot.provenance: QR_DECODE.json binds the current filmed code. Semantic names are established; exact printing aliases are not.

limits: Live-log deck not available in the fresh owner log; no verified dated twenty-slot live snapshot.
QR aliases do not prove exact printed artwork or rarity.
Opponent draws/search identities hidden unless later publicly played; hand fan overlap gives ranges for large fans.
Neither opened discard pile appears in the recording. Play-derived histories are inference, not pile snapshots.
Several first moves occur immediately after a zoomed normal draw. Candidate+1/+3/+6 can already be post-play; actual pre-play evidence and limits are individually identified.
Exact filmed QR semantic list verified; dated readable Pause Games live-log deck snapshot is absent. QR does not resolve artwork/printing aliases.
Native seek requested times are retained; exact decoded PTS was not measured. Turn transition timings are bounded to nearby source frames, not frame-accurate.
